How to play

🎈 Balloon Shoot

Balloons float up on the right — pop as many as you can before time runs out. Watch out for bombs, they hurt!

  • 🖱️ Mouse: press on the bow and drag backwards (away from the balloons) to aim, release to shoot.
  • ⌨️ Keyboard: tap Space twice and hold on the 2nd tap to draw, use ↑ / ↓ to aim, release to shoot.
  • 📱 Touch: touch the bow and, without lifting your finger, drag backwards (away from the balloons) to aim. Let go to shoot.
  • 🎈 Each balloon popped: +1 point.
  • 💣 Each bomb hit: −1 point.
  • ⏱️ You've got 30 seconds. Go!
⏱️ Time's up
